scope: Two minimal-Python observers and one actor-created private-UI control; no worker or product admission
basis: Prior observer imports ctypes before its first receipt, so absent output does not independently locate the failure before the Python interpreter's first instruction.
retained_tenth_result: Standard reached every import/DLL marker; restricted produced no marker. Collector failed on Windows CRLF versus its LF assertion. Preserve that result and make the observer's producer format explicitly LF; do not relax marker expectations.
actor_ui_control: A fixed trusted fresh-standard-user bootstrap creates its own new CWF_CREATE_ONLY private station/desktop before deriving the same exact-user-only restricted token and using AsUser. Record creation failure or the actual nested process outcome. No shared object changes,extra privileges or policy grants. This tests the creator/logon boundary separately from changing leaf-object ACLs; no automatic fallback.
required: Standard control must exit0 and reach complete. Retain exact restricted exit,flushed capped breadcrumb file or its absence,and bounded standard output. Distinguish interpreter entry,individual imports and explicit DLL loading. Collection completeness is not successful restricted startup.
minimal_pair_constants: Same fresh account,private desktop,environment,job-before-resume and32MiB cap; exact user-only restricting token. No new token,permission,API or resource-policy variation.
